item.title: Northbay T100 results: Lind & Berg win
item.description: Sofia Lind won the Northbay T100 in 1:52:30, ahead of Anna Keller (1:53:02) and Rina Sato.
item.content:encoded:
Sofia Lind won the Northbay T100 in 1:52:30, ahead of Anna Keller (1:53:02) and Rina Sato. Jonas Berg won the men’s race in 1:41:10 ahead of Theo Grant.

It was Lind's second T100 win of the season, and Keller stays within 16 points of the series lead.
